skills.label: Build for Claude
skills.desc: Build a plugin people use inside Claude: an MCP connector to your product, skills for your workflows, optional MCP Apps UI, and a listing in the directory. Source: https://claude.com/docs/build/overview

skills.label: Connectors directory
skills.desc: Browse verified and community MCP connectors in the Connectors Directory, one catalog for claude.ai, Claude Desktop, mobile, Claude Code, and Cowork Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/directory

skills.label: Get started with connectors
skills.desc: Connect Claude to an app or service from the Connectors directory, turn the connector on in a conversation, and manage or disconnect it later. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started

skills.label: Connector verification
skills.desc: How Anthropic reviews connectors in the directory, what the Verified, Community, and Custom labels mean, and how to stay safe with third-party connectors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/verification

skills.label: Manage your listing after publishing
skills.desc: Update your MCP server, plugin, and directory listing after publication, keep your listing URL stable, and delist when you need to. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/after-publishing

skills.label: Authentication for connectors
skills.desc: Meet Claude's OAuth requirements for remote MCP servers: supported authentication types, client registration, discovery, callback URLs, and token refresh. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/authentication

skills.label: Directory connectors vs custom connectors
skills.desc: Compare directory-listed and custom connectors: Anthropic review, in-product discovery, install links, Suggested Connectors, and per-tenant URL listings. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/directory-vs-custom

skills.label: Enterprise Managed Auth for connectors
skills.desc: Accept identity assertions from a customer's identity provider or Claude so users connect to your MCP server without an OAuth consent step. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/enterprise-managed-auth

skills.label: Build an MCP server for Claude
skills.desc: Build a remote MCP server that people use as a connector in Claude: where it runs, authentication, what it exposes, size and timeout limits, and distribution. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/index

skills.label: Lazy authentication for MCP servers
skills.desc: Let users call public tools immediately and defer OAuth until a protected tool is actually invoked. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/lazy-authentication

skills.label: Manage your directory listing
skills.desc: Track submissions, monitor server health and usage metrics, and edit your directory listing Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/managing-your-listing

skills.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
skills.desc: Get oriented to the Model Context Protocol, the open standard behind Claude's connectors: local and remote servers, tools, resources, and prompts. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp

skills.label: Design guidelines
skills.desc: Design MCP Apps that feel native to Claude: display modes, mobile layout, visual style, interaction patterns, and the host's style variables. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/design-guidelines

skills.label: Open external links from MCP Apps
skills.desc: Declare allowed link destinations so ui/open-link requests from your directory connector's MCP App open without Claude's confirmation modal. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/external-links

skills.label: Get started with MCP Apps
skills.desc: Try example MCP Apps in Claude Desktop, then use the MCP Apps SDK, examples, and agent skills to add interactive UI to your own MCP server. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/getting-started

skills.label: Supersede older widget instances
skills.desc: Keep only the newest copy of an MCP App widget active when Claude calls its tool more than once in a conversation, using a server key and BroadcastChannel. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/instance-supersession

skills.label: Add an interactive UI to your MCP server
skills.desc: Add an MCP App to the quickstart MCP server: register a ui:// resource with the MCP Apps SDK, link it to a tool, and check that the server advertises the UI. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/quickstart

skills.label: Blend your MCP App with Claude's theme
skills.desc: Make your MCP App's background transparent and style it with Claude's host style variables so it blends into the conversation in light and dark mode. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/transparent-theming

skills.label: Troubleshoot MCP Apps
skills.desc: Debug MCP Apps in Claude with developer tools on desktop and iOS, and fix invisible apps, large tool results, iOS-only request failures, and ui.domain errors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/troubleshooting

skills.label: Build a desktop extension with MCPB
skills.desc: Package a local MCP server as a single-click .mcpb install for Claude Desktop: when to build one, the CLI quickstart, manifest.json, and how users install it. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcpb

skills.label: Build your first MCP server for Claude
skills.desc: Build a minimal MCP server with one tool in JavaScript, run it on your machine, and connect it to Claude Code so Claude calls your tool. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/quickstart

skills.label: Connector pre-submission checklist
skills.desc: Check your MCP connector against what Anthropic reviewers test, including tool design, prompt-injection patterns, and functional quality, before you submit. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/review-criteria

skills.label: Submit a connector to the directory
skills.desc: Submit a remote MCP server or MCP App to the Connectors Directory through the developer portal: requirements, screenshot specs, and what each step asks for. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/submission

skills.label: Test your connector
skills.desc: Test your MCP server against Claude as a custom connector before you submit it to the directory, including a local server exposed through a tunnel. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/testing

skills.label: Troubleshoot your connector
skills.desc: Diagnose and resolve common connection, authorization, and tool-call failures for custom and directory MCP connectors Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/troubleshooting

skills.label: Decide what to include in your plugin
skills.desc: Decide which pieces your Claude plugin needs: an MCP connector backed by a server you host, skills, commands, agents, or UI, and how they're listed together. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/what-to-build

skills.label: Add a connector that isn't in the directory
skills.desc: Connect Claude to an MCP server that isn't in the Connectors Directory, by its URL or as a local desktop extension. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/add-unlisted

skills.label: GitHub integration
skills.desc: Add a GitHub repository to a conversation, or files and folders from a repository to a project, so Claude can read your code Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/github/index

skills.label: Google Calendar
skills.desc: Connect the Google Calendar connector so Claude can answer questions about your meetings, attendees, and availability. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/google/calendar

skills.label: Google Drive
skills.desc: Connect the Google Drive connector so Claude can search your Drive, read Docs, Sheets, Slides, and PDFs, and use Drive files in chats and projects. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/google/drive

skills.label: Gmail
skills.desc: Connect the Gmail connector so Claude can search your email and answer questions from your messages, with citations back to each one. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/google/gmail

skills.label: Authenticate to MCP servers behind a tunnel
skills.desc: Make OAuth sign-in work for MCP servers reached through an MCP tunnel when the authorization server or identity provider is inside your network. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/mcp-tunnels/oauth

skills.label: MCP tunnels
skills.desc: Connect Claude to MCP servers inside your private network without opening inbound firewall ports or exposing the servers to the internet. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/mcp-tunnels/overview

skills.label: Set up an MCP tunnel
skills.desc: Create a Tunnels API key, deploy the MCP tunnel stack with Helm or Docker Compose, verify the connection, and add tunneled MCP servers as custom connectors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/mcp-tunnels/setup

skills.label: Troubleshoot MCP tunnels
skills.desc: Fix MCP tunnel problems: cloudflared won't connect, tools don't appear, routing and IP validation errors, TLS and certificate failures, and OAuth errors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/mcp-tunnels/troubleshooting

skills.label: Microsoft 365 connector
skills.desc: Connect SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams to Claude so it can search, analyze, and act on your Microsoft 365 information Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/microsoft/365

skills.label: Slack integration
skills.desc: Use Claude directly in your Slack workspace with the Claude in Slack app, and let Claude search Slack with the Slack connector Source: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/slack/index

skills.label: Publish to the directory
skills.desc: Submit a plugin or MCP connector to Anthropic's directory: the two submission kinds, who can submit, what review involves, and where to start. Source: https://claude.com/docs/directory/publish

skills.label: Track your directory submission
skills.desc: Look up the status the developer portal shows for a plugin bundle or MCP connector submission: what it means, who acts next, and who to contact. Source: https://claude.com/docs/directory/submission-status

skills.label: Connectors, skills, and plugins
skills.desc: Choose how to customize Claude: MCP connectors give it access to your tools, skills teach it how you do a task, and plugins package both as one install. Source: https://claude.com/docs/extend/overview

skills.label: Manage plugins for your organization
skills.desc: Control which plugins members of your Team or Enterprise organization can use in claude.ai and Cowork: see what you have, add your own, and set availability. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/admin

skills.label: Plugin structure and testing
skills.desc: Reference for the plugin folder: what each file is, the manifest fields every app reads, bundling an MCP connector with its skill, and testing on each app. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/build

skills.label: Create a plugin with Claude
skills.desc: Make a plugin for your own workflow from claude.ai or the desktop app without writing files: choose Create with Claude and answer Claude's questions. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/create-with-claude

skills.label: Roll out a plugin to your whole organization
skills.desc: Get your organization's plugin to members in claude.ai and Cowork and to developers in Claude Code by using organization settings and managed settings together. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/org-rollout

skills.label: Sync your organization's plugins from a repository
skills.desc: Distribute your organization's plugins from a GitHub or GitLab repository through organization settings, including repository requirements and GitLab setup. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/org-sync

skills.label: Plugins
skills.desc: Add plugins to Claude: what a plugin adds, where to find and install one, and where it's available across chat, Cowork, and Claude Code. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/overview

skills.label: Plugin feature support across platforms
skills.desc: Look up which plugin components and install paths work in claude.ai chat, Cowork, and Claude Code, and why a plugin behaves differently on each. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/platform-support

skills.label: Plugin pre-submission checklist
skills.desc: Fix every finding before you submit a plugin to the Claude plugin directory: what the developer portal's validation and scan check, and what each result means. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/pre-submission-checklist

skills.label: Build your first plugin
skills.desc: Build a plugin with one skill and an optional MCP connector, test it in Claude Code, validate it, and push it to GitHub, ready to submit your own. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/quickstart

skills.label: Share a plugin with teammates
skills.desc: Share a plugin you made with specific people in your Team or Enterprise organization, or publish it to your organization's library. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/share

skills.label: Submit your plugin
skills.desc: Submit a plugin from a GitHub repository to Anthropic's directory through the developer portal, follow its review, publish it, and release updates. Source: https://claude.com/docs/plugins/submit

skills.label: Create custom skills
skills.desc: Create a custom skill for Claude: write the SKILL.md file, add resources and scripts, package the skill, and test it. Source: https://claude.com/docs/skills/how-to

skills.label: Skills overview
skills.desc: Find, turn on, and use skills: directories of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads to handle specific tasks Source: https://claude.com/docs/skills/overview

skills.label: Welcome
skills.desc: Connect Claude to your tools, teach it how your team works, and put it to work in Slack, on your desktop, in Microsoft 365, or through the Claude API. Source: https://claude.com/docs/index
